declared: H15 Phase 1 (Gate 0), before any candidate-language encoding exists
purpose: Classes of under-specified / ambiguous inputs that every candidate surface must reject or leave unresolved. Each surface instantiates every applicable class with >=2 concrete cases; a case 'fails closed' when compilation raises (expected 'error') or reports the address as unresolved (expected 'unresolved') instead of inventing semantics.

classes.description: A property, parameter or function output without a type, or with a type that is neither a primitive nor a ref/list/optional constructor.
A link type without a from/to cardinality, or a cardinality missing its min or max (including an empty/null bound).
A resource whose kind is not stated or is mixed up, in particular a Function/Action distinction left unstated (no kind marker, or fields of both kinds, or the fields that decide the kind removed).
An authority rule with no allow/deny effect.
A package, action or policy with no version.
A property with no required flag (or a null one). Defaults exist only for flags the IR schema defaults (immutable, directed, delegation_allowed, parameter required).
A reference address that matches more than one resource (same id in two kinds where either is legal, or a duplicated id).
A reference address that matches no resource in the package or its imports.
A value (record atom / key / list item) that fills no slot the surface declares.
Text whose structure admits more than one reading: duplicate keys, aliases/anchors/tags, several documents, scalars that could be string or number or bool, indentation the grammar cannot place.
A token or key outside the surface vocabulary: unknown enum member, unknown primitive, unknown key, unknown type-constructor key.

fail_closed_property: for any valid encoding E and any deletion mutant M of E: compile(M) raises/returns unresolved, OR render(compile(M)) == canonical(M)  (the compiler may accept M only if M fully determines what it compiles to)
fail_closed_property_notes: canonical(M) is the surface's own canonical text of the IR that M literally states (absent fields stay absent, nothing defaulted into the IR). A compiler that accepts M and returns an IR containing anything M does not state has invented semantics and is a falsifier hit for H15.

applicability.candidate_surfaces: to be instantiated by the later candidate-language phase against the same class list; a class with no analogue on that surface must be listed as such with a reason, not dropped
